feature: Add --enable-historical-defect-context feature flag to run_eval.py (default off)
problem: Historical defect context injection is always active when _HISTORICAL_DEFECT_CONTEXT_AVAILABLE=True and csv_features is populated. The measured D3 lift is +0.01±0.03 — within noise. There is no way to A/B test or disable it without code changes. Per-commit forensics JSON has no record of whether historical context was actually injected, making eval forensics incomplete.
proposed_solution: 1) Add `enable_historical_defect_context: bool = False` and `historical_defect_context_status: str | None = None` fields to InvestigationContext dataclass (context/context_builder.py). 2) In `build_investigation_messages()` (hypothesis/hypothesis_engine.py), gate the _get_historical_defect_context call on `context.enable_historical_defect_context`; set `context.historical_defect_context_status` to one of: disabled | injected | fallback | unavailable. 3) Add `--enable-historical-defect-context` CLI flag (default False) to run_eval.py; wire to `context.enable_historical_defect_context` before each investigation; include in run_config JSON. 4) Update _save_investigation to write `historical_defect_context_status` as a top-level key in the per-commit investigation JSON.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: When `context.enable_historical_defect_context=False` (CLI default), `_get_historical_defect_context` is never called. Unit test mocks `commit_investigator.hypothesis.hypothesis_engine._get_historical_defect_context`, calls `build_investigation_messages()` with `enable_historical_defect_context=False` and populated `csv_features`; asserts `mock.call_count == 0`, user message contains no `## Historical Context` section, and `missing_reasons` does not include any string containing `Historical context`.

AC-2: Per-commit investigation JSON written to `inv_dir` contains top-level key `historical_defect_context_status` with value exactly one of {injected, fallback, unavailable, disabled}. Unit test exercises `_save_investigation` (or its serialized dict) with `historical_defect_context_status='disabled'` and asserts the key is present at top level with that value.

AC-3: Default for `--enable-historical-defect-context` is False — `run_eval.py --help` shows the flag, argparse `store_true` default is False when absent, and `run_config.json` written by `_save_run_config` includes `"enable_historical_defect_context": false` on a default run.
AC-4: `rg 'enable-h3a|h3a_status' src/` returns zero matches (no experiment-vocabulary names leak into production code).

AC-5: When `context.enable_historical_defect_context=True` and mocked `_get_historical_defect_context` returns a non-empty string, `build_investigation_messages()` sets `context.historical_defect_context_status='injected'`, user message contains `## Historical Context`, and mock `call_count == 1`.

AC-6: `run_eval.py` `run_investigations()` sets `context.enable_historical_defect_context` from the parsed CLI arg before calling the orchestrator (unit test or source inspection: `context.enable_historical_defect_context` mirrors `self.enable_historical_defect_context` / `args.enable_historical_defect_context`).
AC-7: `pytest` from `.venv` exits 0 with ≥465 passed; `tests/test_hypothesis_engine.py` and `tests/test_historical_rag.py` pass with no regressions.
edge_cases: EC-1: Flag=False and `_HISTORICAL_DEFECT_CONTEXT_AVAILABLE=True` with populated `csv_features` — `historical_defect_context_status='disabled'`, `_get_historical_defect_context` never called, user message has no `## Historical Context` and no historical-context entry in `missing_reasons`.
EC-2: Flag=True and `_HISTORICAL_DEFECT_CONTEXT_AVAILABLE=False` (import failed) — `historical_defect_context_status='unavailable'`, no exception raised, user message has no `## Historical Context`.

EC-3: Flag=True and `_get_historical_defect_context` raises an exception — `historical_defect_context_status='unavailable'`, warning logged, investigation continues (no crash, no `## Historical Context`).

EC-4: Flag=True and `_get_historical_defect_context` returns None despite populated `csv_features` — `historical_defect_context_status='unavailable'`, `missing_reasons` includes a historical-context-unavailable reason, no `## Historical Context` section.

EC-5: Flag=True and historical defect context uses project-level fallback (KNN classified < `_MIN_CLASSIFIED_FOR_KNN`) — `historical_defect_context_status='fallback'`, user message contains `## Historical Context` with `project-wide` in the injected block.
verification_method: Run `pytest` from `.venv` (exit 0, ≥465 passed). Run `rg 'enable-h3a|h3a_status' src/` (zero matches). Run `python src/commit_investigator/runners/run_eval.py --help | grep -F enable-historical-defect-context` to confirm flag exists. Run unit tests covering AC-1/AC-2/AC-5 and edge cases EC-1 through EC-5; assert investigation JSON top-level `historical_defect_context_status` and `run_config.json` key `enable_historical_defect_context: false` on default run.
evaluator_notes: STRENGTHENED (round 1). Fixed wrong function name build_investigation_prompt→build_investigation_messages; fixed proposed_solution dataclass default True→False to match CLI/task intent. AC-1: added missing_reasons regression guard (state.json baseline-equivalence). AC-2: top-level JSON key + exact disabled value, not mere presence. Added AC-5 positive enable path (injected status + prompt section). Added AC-6 run_eval wiring criterion. AC-7: explicit test file regression scope (replaces vague AC-5). Edge cases: EC-4 None-return unavailable path; EC-5 fallback status. Removed manual-only 'inspect sample JSON' as sole forensics check — unit tests required. Status taxonomy unchanged.
